title: Safe Latent Diffusion: Mitigating Inappropriate Degeneration in Diffusion Models
reasoning: The paper centers on the ethical alignment of generative models with human moral norms and 'right' and 'wrong' values. It introduces the I2P benchmark to evaluate and mitigate content that violates ethical and social standards, such as hate speech, harassment, and illegal activity, and discusses the ethical implications of data curation and model safety throughout.
